caption: The drawing depicts two views of a small, red building with a square base and a pyramid-shaped roof, both with metallic gray and green surfaces. The larger main view shows a front-facing perspective of the building with the word "BANK" written above the entrance. The entrance features a door flanked by two windows with multiple panes, and a small set of green steps leading up to it. There are diamond-shaped decorations visible on the corners of the building. The roof is predominantly gray with a smaller elevated section topped by a green element. The secondary view, located in the upper right, presents a side or angled view of the same building, focusing on a face covered with a grid of circular holes, a slot, and a screw in the center, with a diamond-shaped cutout in the upper raised section. Both versions are bordered by a thin rectangular frame on a plain, light background. The illustration is signed “W.O. Fletcher” in the lower right corner.
title: Red School House Bank
